description:
Hushfeed v0.34.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Two new patches are on by default. Keep the Favorites tab: TikTok's server can put an account into an experiment that empties the Favorites tab on the profile, and the patch answers the two gates behind it with the values that keep the tab. Comment publish diagnostics: when a comment will not post, the report says whether the send reached TikTok's publish code, what it had in hand, and whether it returned early or handed the comment to the request. Reposting a video no longer arms the send confirmation step. The diagnostic report grew a Feature Gate Lab section, counts profile lists that arrived empty, names anything a route was handed that is not a video, gives the profile video pager's ad event its own line, lists what the profile routes kept when logging is on, and says which playback quality gear was picked. AMOLED dark theme reaches the comments and share sheets. The Blocked banner clears the tab bar and the comment box. Search settings opens focused with the keyboard up, refused dialog values are announced, the SIM preset list marks the chosen preset, greyed rows say which switch turns them on, the backup rows say what is running, and the Feature Gate Lab's structured editor shows pending edits and can turn overrides on in place.

Validation: 1356 runtime tests passed locally, plus 203 in the patches module. The bundle carries 81 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
